productVersion: 27.3.0-rc.2 (published signed release candidate; npm/source review 2026-11-13; standalone Node 26.13.1; stable baseline 27.2.5 retains node-forge 1.4.2)

checks.assessment: No package entries in the 2026-11-13 audit; production audit, 44/44 EMS and security/certificate/runtime checks passed in signed Windows workflow 43415690895. Node 26.13.1 is now the standalone development/CI baseline and stable standalone server floor. Standalone Node 24 is blocked after a separate known WASM/V8 crash; embedded Node 24 requires separately checked Electron/Chromium V8 floors. No WASM-GC workaround or solver lifecycle change was applied. Node-forge stays 1.4.3; stable 27.2.5 and beta 4 retain 1.4.2, so these counts do not apply to them. No new API/role/schema is introduced. Actual external executables require update/restart; full backups, site acceptance and stable-readiness limitations remain.

No package entries in the 2026-11-13 audit. Windows gate passed 2546 emulator tests (10 existing skips) and 1644 Chromium/Firefox/WebKit checks after the complete local gate. Explicit switch/supply clicks resume Play in View/Cmd/Sim, not History; simulation remains simulation. Offline/unknown configured switch connections use half-opacity without adding a lockout. Editor layering prevents background pointer interception. A WebKit fixture now awaits actual animation settlement without weakening geometry checks. No new command authority, automatic switching or safety guarantee is introduced; event-driven guide and reconnect/plant-state limits remain.

No package entries in the 2026-11-13 audit; unchanged node-forge 1.4.3 and Windows production audit/PKI/TLS/certificate regressions passed. VO-SA-2026-004 adds published RC 2 to the reviewed patched prerelease scope, separately from the older RSA notice. No new Forge correction or general exploitability/non-exploitability claim is made. Existing key-material preservation, separate tooling updates and certificate/fingerprint trust commissioning remain necessary.

No package entries in the 2026-11-13 audit. Build tooling now uses Node 26.13.1; camera-worker application logic is unchanged from RC 1. Milesight/RTSP support is not part of this RC. Native decoder/runtime verification remains a separate scope.

No package entries in the 2026-11-13 audit. Runtime engine metadata retains the checked embedded Electron case alongside the raised standalone floor. Shared topology validation and project/storage schemas remain unchanged from RC 1; preserve backups when repairing inconsistent projects. Local build interference caused transient missing output, not a shipped schema or validation change.

No package entries in the 2026-11-13 audit. Local and authoritative Windows gates built manual HTML/PDF, including click-to-Play, connection-opacity/editor-layering behavior and standalone-versus-Electron runtime/update requirements. Documentation builds are not safety or security certification.

checks.scope: Complete application npm dependency tree, including dev-declared shipped Electron
checks.assessment: Six moderate package entries remain through minimatch (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249), @electron/universal, app-builder-lib, dmg-builder, electron-builder and electron-builder-squirrel-windows. These are one advisory/dependent-chain entries, not six distinct CVEs. No high/critical npm entries were reported. Electron remains 44.10.1, above the 44.9.1 patched floor for GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9. Its embedded Node 24.22.1 / Chromium 152.0.7977.169 decoder is reviewed separately. The build-tool audit is not clean; isolate tooling from untrusted input and network exposure.
